Meera Singh: Quick update  we're naming Tomas Li as interim Head of Customer Reliability while we recruit a permanent lead. Tomas starts Monday and will own backlog prioritization, on-call rota changes, and hiring coordination for the next 90 days.

Tomas Li: Happy to help. My immediate asks: teams with critical tickets please add an "impact" flag in the desk board and cc me. I'll set up a 30-min sync Wed to hear blockers.

Ana Martinez: Thanks Meera/Tomas. Will there be a posting for the permanent role?

Meera Singh: Yes  REQ-5120 will go live next week. Internal candidates prioritized for the first 10 business days.

Samir Patel: Recruiters standing by. If you have referrals DM me or use the new internal-referral form. We'll run an interview panel pilot to shorten timelines.

Claire Wu: Note on comp: standard bands apply; submit comp-exception cases with market data if needed. I'll review within 48hrs.

HR Bot: Reminder  add any expected changes to headcount to the central HR sheet by Fri EOD to ensure approvals are routed.

Meera Singh: Thanks all  Tomas will post a short 90-day plan in #people-ops Monday. Ping me or Claire for edge cases.
